name: trade-credit-summary
title: Trade credit summary
description: A trade customer's credit at a glance: what is available, a meter that warns in words, payment terms, what is overdue and the next due date.
docs: Pass limit and used in minor units, terms in words ('30 days net'), nextDue ({ date, amount }) and overdue ({ amount, count, since }); account is a line under the heading. The big figure is what is available to spend and the meter shows what is used. It warns in words from warnAt (default 0.8) of the limit, 'You have used 91% of your credit. An order over €2,250.00 may wait until a payment clears.', and says so when nothing is left. The meter, the badge and the words read the same unrounded share, so they agree on where 'near' begins; the meter turns red from 95 percent, or from warnAt when that is higher. The badge reads Good standing, Near your limit, Limit reached, Payment overdue or On hold, always as words with a glyph. overdue gets its own line with the amount, how many invoices and the oldest due date, and a Pay now button when onPay is passed: return a promise and it shows it is working; reject and the line says the payment could not start. blocked ({ reason, contact }) puts a notice at the top, takes the figure to zero and says who to call. requestForm is a slot that opens under 'Request a higher limit' (defaultRequestOpen opens it at first) and onRequestIncrease is called when it opens; without a form the button only calls it, and without either there is no button. The limit, the terms and the next due date sit beside their words once the card is wide enough and under them in a narrow column. Due dates are <time> elements, every amount is in tabular figures, and currency, locale, timeZone, headingAs and labels do the usual.
